summary: n8n_execute refuses n8n-packages.import-package with an error pointing at the CLI upload command.
reason: POST /n8n-packages/import requires multipart/form-data with a binary package part; the code-orchestration route only sends JSON bodies, so the request could never succeed. The CLI command already performs the multipart upload. Generator template gap.
validated_outcome: TestCodeOrchRefusesMultipartImport returns a tool error naming n8n-pp-cli n8n-packages import-package --package.
